label: AUDUSD cross-asset London opening-range continuation into New York (Friday longs) true 4R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `SI London opening-range continuation into New York (Friday longs)`. Session-window return predicts a later same-day session return. Filtered by signalWeekdaySide=4_long. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 4:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
